project_type: Full-stack MERN app — Express/MongoDB backend + Create React App (react-scripts 5) frontend
language: JavaScript (JSX for React components, CommonJS for Node backend)
build_system: Create React App (react-scripts 5.0.1). No custom webpack config. ESLint rules inherited from react-app. Build must pass with exit 0.
test_framework: react-scripts test (Jest + React Testing Library). No tests written yet — do not run tests, just ensure build passes.
verification_instructions: Run `cd /Users/amiteshkumardubey/Desktop/jobTracker/client && npm run build`. Must exit 0 with no compilation errors. Warnings about unused variables/imports are acceptable; errors are not. Also verify the dev server starts: `cd /Users/amiteshkumardubey/Desktop/jobTracker/client && npm start` (port 3001 via .env PORT=3001).
environment_constraints: Backend is on http://localhost:5002. Frontend is on port 3001 (set in client/.env as PORT=3001). REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5002 is in client/.env — NEVER change these. Do NOT modify any backend ports, JWT logic, or MongoDB config. The fallback in services/api.js still says 5001 but REACT_APP_API_URL overrides it — leave the fallback as-is.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code conventions: functional components, hooks, CSS classes from index.css (no CSS modules, no Tailwind), react-hot-toast for notifications, axios via the shared api.js service.
key_patterns: 1) All API calls go through client/src/services/api.js (axios instance with Bearer token interceptor). 2) CSS is entirely in src/index.css using CSS custom properties (--bg, --primary, etc.) — components use className strings mapping to these global classes. 3) State management is local useState + Context (AuthContext). 4) Routes are in App.jsx using react-router-dom v6. 5) Protected pages wrap with <ProtectedRoute><AppLayout>...</AppLayout></ProtectedRoute>. 6) Backend returns { success, data } envelope. Stats endpoint returns { success, data: { total, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected } }. 7) Application model fields: company, role, status (Applied/Interview/Offer/Rejected), location, jobLink, appliedDate, notes. All new fields must be optional with defaults so existing data is unaffected.
directory_structure: jobTracker/ — root. client/ — CRA frontend (src/ has pages/, components/, layouts/, context/, hooks/, services/, utils/). server/ — Express backend (models/, routes/, controllers/, middleware/). .agents/tasks/ — FEAT artifacts (NOT inside the worktree's git-tracked paths, but physically under jobTracker/.agents — keep this in mind when committing: .agents should be gitignored or the coder must not stage it).
